# How to run tests

To run the test suite, run the following command:

```bash
cargo test --workspace
```

To run the test suite in release mode, run the following command:

```bash
cargo test --workspace --release
```

The repository's full gate battery (rendered gates, `ggen sync run`, receipt
chain check) runs as a single command:

```bash
make verify
```

To run the fail-closed pre-publish gate (checks clean tree, aligned package versions,
clippy, workspace tests, workspace dry-run, and the 32 MiB WASM ceiling):

```bash
bash scripts/publish_gate.sh
```
